verdict.rationale: Clerk's pricing matrix lists passkeys as an authentication method ("Authenticate with any form of passkeys"), its site advertises email and SMS one-time passcodes with brute-force prevention, and the changelog adds passkeys as a second factor. Together these cover passkey and email-OTP passwordless sign-in as product features, though passkeys are gated to Pro and higher plans. Missing for 10: any evidence of magic-link sign-in, in-depth setup docs for passkey/OTP sign-in flows (evidence is mostly pricing and marketing copy), passkeys on the Free plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
